name: FUN_BC_INTERFACE_PARAMS
description: This table stores the input and output parameters for each interface.

columns.name: INPUT_OUTPUT_FLAG
columns.description: Type of the attribute. Allowed values are 1 and 2. 1 means input parameter, 2 means output parameter.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_NAME
columns.description: The name of the interface attribute.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the type of the attribute. Allowed values are: number,string,object,array.

columns.name: MAX_LENGTH
columns.description: The maximum length of the attribute.

columns.name: DEFAULT_VALUE
columns.description: The default value of the attribute.

columns.name: REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the attribute is required.

columns.name: FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: Format of the attribute,such as YYYY-MM-DD for data.

columns.name: PARENT_ATTRIBUTE_ID
columns.description: Parent attribute identifier of the attribute.The parent attribute id of the root arrtibute is 0.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
